reviews.summary: Server 0.10.4 preserves player 0.10.3 sync, playlist schema 1, and same-origin APK update metadata; GitHub source adds verified mirroring only. 152 Node, 89 Python and 13 native Java tests plus landing/download browser checks pass; physical TV upgrade acceptance remains pending.

Corrects the prior Android enrollment review: new registration returns HTTP 201, which player 0.10.3 rejected. Player 0.10.4 now pairs with the existing server API; direct GitHub updates remove dependence on server APK routes while preserving optional server source and metadata schema. 25 native tests include real Express enrollment/restart/approval; 152 Node and 89 Python tests pass. Physical TV installation remains pending.

Player 0.10.5 adds a persisted per-device automatic-update setting that defaults off; manual checks remain available and APK source selection, package identity, signatures, sync protocol, and server contracts are unchanged.

Server refreshes slide snapshots in existing playlist manifests, can copy slide audience grants to uploaded assets, and converts GIFs to animated WebP; player sync and manifest schema 1 remain unchanged.
Add playlist sharing confirmation without changing player APIs
Add playlist access preflight and sharing confirmation; player contract unchanged
Playlist manifests can now contain downloadable font assets; updated Pi and Android players cache and render them
Custom fonts are added as playlist assets; player 0.10.6 adds font download, caching, and rendering
Slide save now clamps edge-aligned dimensions and positions; playlist and player contracts unchanged

Server 0.14.1 publishes manifest schema 2 for removed-media placeholders; player 0.10.7 or newer is required before deleting media used by published slides; updated players continue to accept schema 1
Add nested folders and published-playlist metadata without changing player protocol
Android and Pi agents now accept playlist schema 2 used for removed-media placeholders; schema 1 remains supported

Android 0.10.9 adds read-only inactivity timeout guidance, normal device settings access, and reapplies KEEP_SCREEN_ON on resume. Reviewed Activity diff: enrollment, sync, manifests, cached playback, and APK update contracts are unchanged; existing servers and Pi players remain supported. API 35 native compilation, all 26 native agent/updater/integration tests, repository check, and 22 version/compatibility tests passed. Onn power settings navigation and long-run sleep behavior still require physical device validation.

Server 0.15.1 changes browser account roles and group authorization only; superadmin identities migrate to admin. Player bearer-token enrollment, sync, manifests, media downloads, and Android update contracts remain unchanged. All 159 Node tests including real Python agent integration and 90 Python tests pass with player 0.10.10 sources; no player upgrade required.

Server 0.15.1 updates browser admin roles, descendant group access, user access controls, and safe folder moves. Superadmin identities retain usernames/passwords/sessions as admins. Player bearer-token enrollment/sync, playlist manifests, media delivery, and APK update protocols remain unchanged with player 0.10.10; no player upgrade required. Full 159-test Node suite and 90 Python tests passed, followed by all 43 affected account/server tests including the added hidden-folder cycle regression. Accounts and organization Chromium checks passed for desktop/mobile controls and drag/drop.

Schema 3 playlists using shapes, stock quotes, or vertical weather require player 0.10.11; ordinary playlists remain schema 2 and current agents retain schema 1/2 support. Verified Node/Python authorization, migration, quote cache, preview/sync and shared rendering tests; native Android schema 3 forwarding tests pass. Browser rendering and timer checks use mocked providers; live Finnhub keys and physical Pi/Android playback remain unverified.

Library adds visible group hierarchy and direct visible group grant IDs for client-side search/group/status filters. Existing record authorization, player sync and manifest schemas are unchanged; Node authorization regression and full Node/Python suites pass. Server-only update requires no player upgrade.

Final library filters add visible group hierarchy/direct grant IDs and correct publishedSlideIds using embedded published slide IDs. Player sync and manifests are unchanged; no player upgrade needed. All 171 Node and 91 Python tests pass; Chromium verifies nested groups, combined live/publication/connectivity statuses, access-safe metadata, counts, clear filters, independent page state and 320px layout.

Android publication now installs supported SDK command-line tools explicitly. Host JVM unit-test compilation removes only the Android JdkImageInput system restriction and enables jdk.httpserver; production compilation and packaged player code/protocols are unchanged. All 27 native agent/updater/real-server tests pass using the explicit host JDK module. Hosted Gradle tests, lint, signing and pinned-certificate checks still gate APK publication.

Host Android unit tests enable jdk.httpserver and remove only AGP JdkImageInput immediately before test compilation because AGP attaches it after project configuration. Production compilation, shipped code and wire formats are unchanged. All 27 native host tests pass with the explicit module; the publisher retains hosted Gradle tests, lint, signed-APK and pinned-signer gates.

Admin-only group creation and implicit admin group administration change dashboard account policy only; additive accessTags and accountRole summaries leave player sync/manifests unchanged. Verified 173 Node tests including Python agent integration, 91 Python tests, and Chromium sharing, organization, and library-filter flows; existing player 0.10.11 remains compatible.

New-user creation adds a generated password to the admin-only non-cacheable response while preserving the existing invitation field. Users & Groups is admin-only in the dashboard; regular users retain self-service password changes. Player authentication, sync, manifests and content permissions are unchanged. Verified 174 Node tests, 91 Python tests, generated-password login and account navigation in Chromium, typecheck, lint and build; player 0.10.11 remains compatible.

Server 0.17.5 changes workspace UI only: existing recovery-service phases gate supported Wi-Fi controls; assigned-user permissions, player sync, playlist schemas and APK updates remain unchanged for player 0.10.11. Verified 174 Node and 91 Python tests plus populated UI, filters/sorting, accounts, organization, screen setup, editor locks, weather and widgets browser suites.

Player 0.10.12 adds code 1962 as an input alias for the existing public HTTPS origin; no API or playlist protocol changes. Pi and first-boot tests pass. Android Gradle checks could not run here because this workspace has no Android SDK; the hosted Android publication workflow runs those checks.

Server 0.18.1 keeps player 0.10.12 sync and schema 2/3 manifests unchanged: linked forks flatten to ordinary slide/assets/timing publications; management, stable entry IDs, folders, and tags remain server metadata. 52 Node server/access checks and organization/library browser checks passed, including draft isolation and revoked-access publication preservation; renderer, Android and Pi sources unchanged.

Server 0.19.1 uses manifest schema 4 only for data widgets, requiring Pi/Android player 0.10.13. Existing schema 2/3 playlists remain compatible; updated players accept schemas 1-4 and older servers. Live snapshots are separate from publication revisions. Verified 188 Node, 92 Python, 28 native Java tests, feed/live-rendering and library-access browser checks, lint, typecheck, build, and repository checks. Offline restart and online revocation are covered; physical TV/Pi acceptance and APK publication are separate.

Approved server 0.20.0 publishes schema 4 only for live data widgets, requiring player 0.10.13. Existing publications keep schemas 2/3 and updated players accept schemas 1-4 against older servers. 188 Node, 92 Python, 28 native Java tests and feed/library browser checks pass with bounded live/offline snapshots and revoked-data clearing. Lint, typecheck, build and repository checks pass; release workflows will verify native containers and the signed APK.

Server 0.21.1 changes authenticated folder metadata and operator management permissions only; all users see folders while only global admins manage them, preserving item permissions. Uploads remain single-file multipart POST /api/assets with unchanged asset replies. Player sync, enrollment, manifests and Android update contracts are unchanged; player 0.10.13 still supports existing data-widget publications. 189 Node and 92 Python tests plus shared-folder, real HTTP multi-upload/progress/cancellation, library-access, organization, UI-layout and editor browser checks pass.
